name: Voyanta
tagline: Where great companies go to think bigger, together.
positioning: Voyanta orchestrates enterprise offsites end to end — venues, logistics, agendas, and outcomes — so leadership can convene with purpose, not paperwork.

hero.h1: The offsite, elevated to an act of strategy.
hero.sub: Voyanta turns your leadership gathering into a machine for alignment — from the first venue shortlist to the final decision memo — while your people simply show up and think.

features.title: Venue intelligence, curated
features.description: Our team scouts and vets estates, lodges, and campuses worldwide, then matches capacity, travel time, and mood to your agenda — no more 40-tab spreadsheet.

features.title: Agenda architecture
features.description: Design multi-day arcs with session blocks, breakout tracks, and buffer time. Facilitators and decision owners are assigned before anyone lands.

features.title: Logistics on autopilot
features.description: Flights, transfers, dietary needs, and room blocks reconcile in one live itinerary. Every attendee gets a personalized run-of-show on their phone.

features.title: Outcome capture
features.description: Every commitment made in the room becomes a tracked owner-and-deadline artifact, exported to your stack the moment the session ends.

features.title: Spend visibility
features.description: Watch cost accrue per attendee, per day, per track — with real-time budget guardrails your finance team actually approves of.

features.title: Enterprise-grade trust
features.description: SOC 2 Type II, SSO, and regional data residency come standard, so procurement clears you in days, not quarters.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose three weeks of an EA's life planning our exec offsite. Voyanta gave that time back and the sessions were sharper than ever — every decision left the room with an owner.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramaswamy

testimonials.quote: The venue matching alone paid for itself. We convened 180 leaders across two continents and the run-of-show never slipped once.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: Finance loved it more than I did. Watching spend accrue live, per track, meant no surprise invoices in Q4. That never happens with offsites.
testimonials.name: Marta Kessler

pricing.blurb: For single-team offsites that still deserve a real production.

homepage.footerBlurb: Voyanta is the operating system for enterprise convening — turning the offsite from a logistics headache into a strategic instrument.
